title.en: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
title.zh: Anthropic 老板 Dario Amodei 呼吁放慢人工智能发展速度

summary.en: The head of AI company Anthropic, Dario Amodei, has called for a slowdown in the development of artificial intelligence models, citing serious risks that require time for companies and governments to address. He proposed a three-point plan including independent monitoring, industry-wide regulation, and global...
summary.zh: 人工智能公司 Anthropic 的负责人 Dario Amodei 呼吁放慢人工智能模型的开发速度，并对其进行密切监控。他表示，人工智能的发展并非问题所在，但其伴随的风险“非常严重”，需要时间来解决。Amodei...

body.en:
The head of AI company Anthropic has called for the pace of development of artificial intelligence models to slow down and to be closely monitored.

In an essay on Saturday, Dario Amodei said developing AI was not in question, but the risks associated with it were "serious" and companies and governments must be given time to address them.

Amodei proposed a three-point plan that includes independent monitoring of AI models as they are developed, industry-wide regulation and global regulation.

There have been growing concerns recently about the technology's potential risks, the most serious of which suggested there is a greater than 10% chance it "could kill all humans" within the next decade .

Anthropic previously said it had identified and disrupted attempts to use its AI model for "malicious activity" which could support the development of biological weapons.

But the starkest warning came from two employees from Anthropic's safety team who have resigned in the last two weeks saying humanity may not survive , external the race among AI companies to develop machines that are smarter than humans.

As Amodei's proposal made the rounds, even competitors voiced support for the idea of third-party monitors who could evaluate the safety of models as they are developed.

"I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier," wrote OpenAI CEO Sam Altman on X. He called independent evaluators "a great idea."

In a new interview with Fortune Magazine, Altman had sounded similar safety concerns, saying standards were "not at a place" to push AI capabilities much further.

The warnings have prompted calls to action, but US President Donald Trump has so far rejected such fears, saying on Thursday he was concerned "if we don't win AI, we're going to be put in a very bad position".

Some observers have also suggested that Amodei's post was less about safety than about consolidating control over AI technology.

In his essay, called We Must Pace the Frontier, Amodei pointed out that AI had advanced "drastically faster" including its "ability to build the next generation of AI" - and mentioned an incident involving rival OpenAI which has revealed that agents conducted cybersecurity attacks , external on targets they were not asked to attack in July.

The OpenAI agents had "essentially acted as a fanatically devoted collective", Amodei said.

OpenAI has said "the significance of the inter-agent communication activity was not apparent to the leaders" until July and the company was slowing down training of certain advanced AI models and tools as a result, noting that there was now an increased risk of AI tools spiraling out of control.

In his essay, Amodei called for "building AI at a balanced rate that aims to ensure its safety while still achieving its...
body.zh: 人工智能公司Anthropic的负责人呼吁放慢人工智能模型的发展速度并密切监控。 达里奥·阿莫迪在周六的一篇文章中表示，开发人工智能并不是问题，但与之相关的风险是“严重的”，企业和政府必须有时间来解决这些问题。 阿莫代提出了三点计划，包括对人工智能模型开发进行独立监控、全行业监管和全球监管。 最近人们越来越担心这项技术的潜在风险，其中最严重的风险表明，它在未来十年内“可能杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10%。 Anthropic 此前表示，它已经发现并阻止了利用其人工智能模型进行“恶意活动”的企图，这些活动可能支持生物武器的开发。 但最严厉的警告来自 Anthropic 安全团队的两名员工，他们在过去两周辞职，称在人工智能公司开发比人类更聪明的机器的竞赛之外，人类可能无法生存。 随着 Amodei 的提议广为流传，甚至竞争对手也表示支持第三方监控器的想法，第三方监控器可以在模型开发时评估模型的安全性。 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 在 X 上写道：“我同意达里奥的观点，我们需要在前沿领域保持步伐。”他称独立评估者是“一个好主意”。 在《财富》杂志的一次新采访中，奥特曼也表达了类似的安全担忧，称标准“不适合”进一步推动人工智能能力。 这些警告促使人们呼吁采取行动，但美国总统唐纳德·特朗普迄今为止否认了这种担忧，周四表示，他担心“如果我们不能赢得人工智能，我们将处于非常糟糕的境地”。 一些观察家还表示，阿莫迪的帖子与其说是为了安全，不如说是为了巩固对人工智能技术的控制。 阿莫迪在题为“我们必须在前沿迈进”的文章中指出，人工智能的进步“快得多”，包括“构建下一代人工智能的能力”，并提到了涉及竞争对手 OpenAI 的事件，该事件显示特工在 7 月份对他们没有被要求攻击的目标进行了网络安全攻击。 阿莫迪说，OpenAI 特工“本质上是一个狂热奉献的集体”。 OpenAI 表示，直到 7 月，“领导者们才意识到智能体间通信活动的重要性”，因此该公司正在放慢某些先进人工智能模型和工具的培训速度，并指出现在人工智能工具失控的风险增加。 阿莫代在他的文章中呼吁“以平衡的速度构建人工智能，旨在确保其安全性，同时仍然实现......

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of knowledge and technology, particularly in fields like artificial intelligence, is a hallmark of our times. Daniel 12:4 speaks of a time when "many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase." As we witness these advancements, the call for careful consideration and regulation, as voiced by Dario Amodei, echoes the need for...
reflection.zh: 知识和技术的飞速发展，尤其是在人工智能等领域，是我们这个时代的标志。但以理书 12:4 预言了一个“末期”，那时“必有多人来往奔走，知识必然增长”。当我们目睹这些进步时，Dario Amodei 所呼吁的审慎考量和监管，恰恰呼应了需要智慧来引导我们对知识的追求，确保它服务于人类而非带来伤害。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Portsmouth experiences second weekend of anti-immigration protests
title.zh: 朴茨茅斯经历第二个周末的反移民抗议活动

summary.en: Rightwing activists faced a heavy police presence and counter-demonstrations to their march against small boat crossings. Two men and a teenage boy have been arrested in Portsmouth at a far-right protest against immigration. Far-right activists have gathered in Portsmouth for a second weekend after a small boat with...
summary.zh: 右翼活动人士在游行反对小船过境时，面临着严密的警力部署和反示威活动。在朴茨茅斯，两名男子和一名少年因参加反对移民的极右翼抗议活动而被捕。上周日，一艘载有140名寻求庇护者的船只在前往该市途中被拦截后，极右翼活动人士已连续第二个周末聚集在朴茨茅斯。

body.en: Rightwing activists faced a heavy police presence and counter-demonstrations to their march against small boat crossings Two men and a teenage boy have been arrested in Portsmouth at a far-right protest against immigration. Far-right activists have gathered in Portsmouth for a second weekend after a small boat with 140 people seeking asylum on board was intercepted last Sunday while heading towards the city. Continue reading...
body.zh: 右翼活动人士在反对小船过境的游行中面临大量警察的存在和反示威活动，两名男子和一名十几岁的男孩在朴茨茅斯的一次极右翼抗议移民活动中被捕。上周日，一艘载有 140 名寻求庇护者的小船在前往该市的途中被拦截，极右翼活动人士连续第二个周末聚集在朴次茅斯。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Protests against asylum seekers, like those seen in Portsmouth, often arise from fear and a desire for control. Yet, the Bible calls us to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. The 140 individuals on that small boat are not abstract issues but people with stories, hopes, and fears, deserving of dignity and a fair hearing.
reflection.zh: 朴茨茅斯等地针对寻求庇护者的抗议活动，常常源于恐惧和对控制的渴望。然而，圣经呼吁我们为那些无法为自己发声的人说话。那艘小船上的140名乘客并非抽象的议题，而是有故事、有希望、有恐惧的个体，他们理应得到尊严和公正的对待。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Bulgaria investigates fire at weapons site that owner calls sabotage
title.zh: 保加利亚调查武器仓库火灾，业主称是蓄意破坏

summary.en: Bulgarian authorities are investigating an overnight fire at an ammunition storage site run by a private defense company, with the interior minister not ruling out "outside interference." The company, EMCO, which supplies weapons used by Ukraine, stated the blaze was sabotage and ruled out human error. This incident...
summary.zh: 保加利亚当局正在调查一家私营国防公司弹药储存设施发生的夜间火灾，内政部长不排除“外部干预”的可能性。该公司EMCO，为乌克兰提供武器，声称火灾是蓄意破坏，并排除了人为失误的可能性。此次事件紧随上个月在另一家EMCO弹药仓库发生的类似事件，最新火灾未造成人员伤亡，但引发了一系列爆炸。

body.en:
Bulgaria is investigating the cause of an overnight fire at an ammunition storage site run by a private defence company.

Interior Minister Ivan Demerdzhiev said the authorities "are not ruling out outside interference" in the incident in central Bulgaria. No-one was injured in the blaze that triggered a series of explosions.

EMCO company, whose weapons are used by Ukraine against invading Russian forces, said the fire at its site was sabotage and that human error was "completely ruled out". It did not say who might be responsible.

The latest incident follows last month's fire and blasts at another EMCO ammunition warehouse in the area.

In a statement, EMCO said the storage facility that was burned this time - near the central village of Gorni Varpishta, some 170km (106 miles) east of the capital Sofia - had not been used for months and was inspected just 20 days ago, when full compliance with all regulations was confirmed.

It cited a number of similar incidents at Bulgarian defence firms since 2011, saying that the latest was "no exception to the series of acts of sabotage against the Bulgarian defence industry".

"As the EU and Nato member state most severely affected by such actions, Bulgaria must join the collective effort to prevent and neutralise these attacks," EMCO said.

The firm is run by Bulgarian arms dealer Emilian Gebrev, who Bulgarian prosecutors allege has already been targeted by Russian agents.

This includes a poisoning attempt in 2015 of Gebrev, his son and another company employee - three Russian nationals were later charged in absentia for attempted murder.

Bulgaria is a major weapons supplier to Ukraine, as it continues to repel a full-scale Russian invasion launched in 2022.

And although Sofia has recently halted state-owned arms supplies to Ukraine, Bulgarian private defence companies continue such transfers.

Last week, Germany said Russia was responsible for August's drone attack at Leipzig's airport - a claim denied by Moscow as "absurd".

There have also been a number of suspicious fires at defence facilities from Italy to Estonia, with some of the affected countries blaming Russia.
body.zh: 保加利亚正在调查一家私人防务公司经营的弹药储存场夜间起火的原因。 内政部长伊万·德梅尔吉耶夫 (Ivan Demerdzhiev) 表示，当局“不排除外部干预”保加利亚中部的事件。火灾引发了一系列爆炸，没有人受伤。 乌克兰使用EMCO公司的武器来对抗入侵的俄罗斯军队，该公司表示，其现场起火是蓄意破坏，“完全排除了人为失误”。它没有说谁可能对此负责。 最新事件是在上个月该地区另一个 EMCO 弹药仓库发生火灾和爆炸之后发生的。 EMCO在一份声明中表示，这次被烧毁的存储设施位于首都索非亚以东约170公里（106英里）处的戈尔尼瓦尔皮什塔（Gorni Varpishta）中心村庄附近，已经几个月没有使用，仅在20天前进行了检查，确认完全符合所有规定。 报告援引自2011年以来保加利亚国防公司发生的多起类似事件，称最近的一次“对保加利亚国防工业的一系列破坏行为也不例外”。 EMCO 表示：“作为受此类行动影响最严重的欧盟和北约成员国，保加利亚必须共同努力防止和消除这些袭击。” 该公司由保加利亚军火商艾米利安·格布雷夫（Emilian Gebrev）经营，保加利亚检察官称他已成为俄罗斯特工的目标。 其中包括 2015 年对格布雷夫、他的儿子和另一名公司员工的一次投毒未遂事件——三名俄罗斯国民后来因谋杀未遂而被缺席指控。 保加利亚是乌克兰的主要武器供应国，该国继续击退俄罗斯于 2022 年发起的全面入侵。 尽管索非亚最近停止了向乌克兰供应国有武器，但保加利亚私人防务公司仍在继续进行此类转让。 上周，德国称俄罗斯对 8 月份莱比锡机场的无人机袭击负责，但莫斯科否认这一说法“荒谬”。 从意大利到爱沙尼亚的国防设施也发生了多起可疑火灾，一些受影响的国家指责俄罗斯。

reflection.en: The news from Bulgaria speaks of sabotage and explosions at an ammunition site, raising fears of escalating conflict or retaliation. In such moments, the call to "not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good" (Romans 12:21) is a profound challenge. It asks us to resist the urge to meet destruction with more destruction, and instead, to seek paths...
reflection.zh: 保加利亚的这则新闻讲述了弹药库发生的蓄意破坏和爆炸事件，这令人担忧冲突或报复的升级。在这样的时刻，“不可被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶”（罗马书12:21）的呼召是一个深刻的挑战。它要求我们抵制以毁灭回应毁灭的冲动，而是寻求打破暴力循环的道路，即使面对明显的恶意。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Céline Dion fans prepare for comeback concert in Paris
title.zh: 席琳·迪翁巴黎回归演唱会粉丝期待

summary.en: Fans of the Canadian singer greeted her as she left her hotel on Saturday.
summary.zh: 加拿大歌手席琳·迪翁周六离开酒店时受到了粉丝的欢迎。

body.en:
Céline Dion greeted fans today as she left her hotel, hours before she kicked off her comeback concert in Paris.

The Canadian singer returns to the stage on Saturday for her first full concert in six years, to open a sell-out Paris residency after a battle with a rare neurological disorder put a pause in her career.

Some fans arrived as early as 06:00 to get a spot in front of LeRoyal Monceau hotel to catch a glimpse of the star before she left.

She is one of the best-selling music artists of all time and is due to perform a series of 26 concerts over the next eight months.
body.zh: 今天，席琳·迪翁 (Céline Dion) 在离开酒店时向歌迷致意，距离她在巴黎的复出演唱会拉开序幕仅几个小时。 这位加拿大歌手于周六重返舞台，举行六年来的首场完整音乐会，在与罕见的神经系统疾病的斗争导致她的职业生涯暂停后，她在巴黎举办了一场场座无虚席的驻场演出。 一些粉丝早在 06:00 就到达了 LeRoyal Monceau 酒店门前，以便在明星离开前一睹她的风采。 她是有史以来最畅销的音乐艺术家之一，并将在接下来的八个月内举办一系列 26 场音乐会。

reflection.en: After a long battle with a rare neurological disorder that paused her career, Céline Dion is returning to the stage for a sold-out concert in Paris. Her fans, some arriving as early as 6:00 AM, show the deep connection and anticipation for her return. This comeback speaks to the human spirit's capacity to find renewed strength after periods of great trial,...
reflection.zh: 在与罕见的神经系统疾病抗争并暂停演艺生涯后，席琳·迪翁即将重返舞台，在巴黎举行一场门票售罄的演唱会。她的粉丝们，有的甚至凌晨6点就赶来等候，这体现了人们对她回归的深切期待和联系。这次复出展现了人类精神在经历巨大考验后重新获得力量的能力，正如雅伟应许那些等候他的人必得力如展翅的鹰一样。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: Mississippi police say more arrests to come in death of woman found hanging from tree
title.zh: 密西西比警方称，在一名女子被发现吊在树上死亡的案件中，将有更多逮捕行动

summary.en: Mississippi police are continuing their investigation into the death of Tasia Fortune, a Black woman found hanging from a tree last month. The arrest of a man in connection with the killing occurred the day before this update. Loved ones remember Fortune as a mother, athlete, and woman of faith, hoping her legacy...
summary.zh: 密西西比警方仍在调查上个月被发现吊在树上死亡的黑人女子塔西娅·财富（Tasia Fortune）的案件。一名男子因涉嫌杀害她而被捕，此消息发布的前一天。亲友们回忆财富是一位母亲、运动员和有信仰的女性，他们希望她不仅仅因其悲惨的死亡而被铭记。

body.en: Officials still investigating death of Tasia Fortune, a Black woman, a day after man’s arrest in relation to killing Mississippi police said on Saturday they were still investigating the death of Tasia Fortune, a Black woman found hanging from a tree last month, a day after a man was arrested in connection with the killing. Loved ones also painted a picture of Fortune as a mother, athlete and woman of faith who they hoped would not solely be remembered for her horrific death. Continue reading...
body.zh: 密西西比州警方周六表示，他们仍在调查上个月被发现吊死在树上的黑人妇女塔西亚·福琼（Tasia Fortune）的死亡事件，一天前，一名男子因涉嫌谋杀而被捕。亲人们还把福琼描绘成一位母亲、运动员和有信仰的女人，他们希望人们不仅仅因为她的可怕死亡而记住她。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The investigation into Tasia Fortune's death highlights the vulnerability of individuals and the community's need for justice. Loved ones grieve not only the loss but also the potential for her story to be defined solely by its tragic end. The call to 'learn to do good; seek justice, correct oppression; bring relief to the oppressed, defend the fatherless,...
reflection.zh: 对塔西娅·财富死亡的调查凸显了个体的脆弱性以及社区对正义的渴望。亲友们不仅为失去她而悲伤，也为她的故事可能仅仅被其悲惨的结局所定义而痛苦。《以赛亚书》1章17节呼吁“你们要学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的，给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇争辩”，在这样的处境下，这节经文引起了深刻的共鸣。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Uganda's King Oyo buried amid calls for unity over his successor
title.zh: 乌干达国王奥约下葬，呼吁团结确定继承人

summary.en: King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV of Uganda's Tooro kingdom, once the world's youngest reigning monarch, was buried on Saturday. His death has sparked a dispute over his successor, with a TV presenter named as the new monarch, while the late king's family claims he had already chosen an heir.
summary.zh: 乌干达托罗王国国王奥约·尼姆巴·卡班巴·伊古鲁·鲁基迪四世（曾是世界上最年轻的在位君主）于周六下葬。他的去世引发了关于继承人的争议，一名电视节目主持人被宣布为新君主，但已故国王的家人声称他早已选定了继承人。

body.en:
Uganda's King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, once the world's youngest reigning monarch, was buried on Saturday, days after a row broke out over who would succeed him.

Oyo, 34, who had ruled the traditional kingdom of Tooro in western Uganda since the age of three, died last month while undergoing cancer treatment in the US.

Tooro is one of Uganda's traditional kingdoms. They were abolished in 1967 but restored in the 1990s under President Museveni. Their monarchs are recognised as cultural leaders rather than political rulers.

Thousands of mourners lined the streets as the king's casket was transported to the royal tombs in Fort Portal where a private ceremony took place.

Oyo was just a toddler when he was named as Tooro's king and, according to Guinness World Records, was the world's youngest monarch while he reigned.

TV news presenter Prince Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma, 56, who was named as the next monarch by clan elders, reportedly cast nine coffee beans into Oyo's grave, a ritual signifying the end of one reign and the start of another.

But days earlier, Oyo's family rejected Kijanangoma, the late monarch's cousin, as Tooro's new king.

Oyo's sister, Princess Ruth Komuntale, said the late king had left a will, written in 2022, naming his young son as his successor.

Meanwhile, his mother, Queen Best Kemigisa, said royal guards had been withdrawn from the palace and soldiers deployed. This, she said, restricted the royal family's movement and their ability to receive visitors, describing it as "house arrest".

On Saturday, the Archbishop of the Church of Uganda, Stephen Kazimba Mugalu, urged unity.

"Words spoken in grief can cause pain, division and conflict. It can even destroy the legacy of the king we are mourning," he told mourners.

Uganda's President Yoweri Museveni also called for the matter to be resolved "and to favour unity over division".

Omusuuga Charles Karumasi, head of the Babiito royal clan, said: "We have done everything in observance of the culture and traditions of Tooro. We must all preserve peace and serenity."
body.zh: 乌干达国王奥约·宁巴·卡班巴·卡班巴·伊古鲁·鲁基迪四世曾是世界上最年轻的在位君主，于周六下葬，几天前，围绕谁将继承他的王位发生了争吵。 34 岁的奥约从三岁起就统治着乌干达西部的传统王国托罗，上个月在美国接受癌症治疗时去世。 托罗是乌干达的传统王国之一。它们于 1967 年被废除，但在 90 年代穆塞韦尼总统领导下恢复。他们的君主被认为是文化领袖而不是政治统治者。 当国王的灵柩被运送到波特尔堡的皇家陵墓时，数千名哀悼者站在街道两旁，在那里举行了私人仪式。 奥约被任命为托罗国王时，他还是个蹒跚学步的孩子，根据吉尼斯世界纪录，奥约在位期间是世界上最年轻的君主。 56 岁的电视新闻节目主持人爱德华·鲁基迪·基贾南戈马 (Prince Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma) 被部落长老任命为下一任君主，据报道，他将九颗咖啡豆扔进了奥约的坟墓，这一仪式标志着一个统治的结束和另一个统治的开始。 但几天前，奥约的家人拒绝了已故君主的表弟基贾南戈马作为托罗的新国王。 奥约的妹妹露丝·科蒙塔莱公主 (Princess Ruth Komuntale) 表示，已故国王留下了一份于 2022 年撰写的遗嘱，指定他的小儿子为继承人。 与此同时，他的母亲贝斯特·凯米吉萨女王表示，皇家卫队已从宫殿撤出，并部署了士兵。她说，这限制了王室的行动和接待访客的能力，并将其描述为“软禁”。 周六，乌干达教会大主教斯蒂芬·卡津巴·穆加鲁敦促团结。 “悲伤中说出的话语可能会导致痛苦、分裂和冲突。它甚至会毁掉我们哀悼的国王的遗产，”他告诉哀悼者。 乌干达总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼也呼吁解决这一问题，“并支持团结而不是分裂”。 巴比托王室首领 Omusuuga Charles Karumasi 表示：“我们所做的一切都是为了遵守托罗的文化和传统。我们都必须维护和平与安宁。”

reflection.en: The passing of King Oyo, who ascended the throne at a young age, leaves a void and a dispute over succession in the Tooro kingdom. This situation underscores the fragility of leadership transitions and the potential for chaos when a clear path forward is not established. "Where there is no vision, the people perish; but he that keepeth the law, happy is...
reflection.zh: 年幼即位的奥约国王的离世，在托罗王国留下了权力真空和继承权争议。这一局面凸显了领导层交接的脆弱性，以及在缺乏明确前路时可能出现的混乱。“没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便是为有福。”（箴言 29:18）提醒我们，社区的福祉在于远见卓识和对既定秩序的遵守。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: Donations of £72m make Reform’s prospects both rosier and riskier
title.zh: 7200万英镑捐款使改革党前景更加光明，但也更具风险

summary.en: Reform UK has received £72m in donations from billionaires, a sum that significantly boosts its campaign power but also carries risks, potentially alienating ordinary voters who may see it as unleveling the playing field.
summary.zh: 改革党获得了来自亿万富翁的7200万英镑捐款，这笔款项极大地增强了其竞选能力，但也带来了风险，可能会疏远普通选民，他们可能认为这破坏了公平竞争的环境。

body.en: Party can boost its campaign power with funds from billionaire backers, but it can also lose support from ordinary Britons All things being equal, pretty much any political strategist would welcome a £72m war chest; a sum higher than the combined spending of every major party at the 2024 general election. But all things are not equal, and with such a huge amount comes risk. Reform UK has been vocal in its arguments that two sudden £36m windfalls from billionaires Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne merely “levels the playing field” with the bigger parties when it comes to funding. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该党可以利用亿万富翁支持者的资金来增强其竞选实力，但也可能失去普通英国人的支持。在所有条件相同的情况下，几乎任何政治战略家都会欢迎 7200 万英镑的战争基金；这笔金额比 2024 年大选时各主要政党的支出总和还要高。但并非所有事情都是平等的，如此巨大的金额也带来了风险。 Reform UK 一直直言不讳地表示，亿万富翁本·德洛 (Ben Delo) 和克里斯托弗·哈博恩 (Christopher Harbourne) 突然获得的两笔 3600 万英镑的意外之财，只是在资金方面与更大的政党“创造了公平的竞争环境”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The influx of £72 million into Reform UK's campaign coffers, primarily from two billionaires, presents a complex situation. While it offers greater capacity for their message, it also raises concerns about fairness and the perception of undue influence. This situation prompts reflection on how financial power impacts political discourse and whether such...
reflection.zh: 改革党获得了来自两位亿万富翁的7200万英镑捐款，这笔巨款为其竞选活动提供了强大的资金支持，但也引发了关于公平性和潜在影响力的担忧。这笔资金的涌入，虽然增强了其传播信息的能力，却也可能疏远普通民众，让他们觉得政治竞争的天平被打破了。这促使我们反思，经济实力如何影响政治话语，以及如此巨额、集中的捐款是否真正服务于更广泛的公众利益，这与‘行公义，好怜悯’的呼召不...

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Donald Trump says he would ‘love’ to see united Ireland
title.zh: 特朗普表示“乐见”统一爱尔兰

summary.en: During a visit to the Republic of Ireland, US President Donald Trump stated he would "love" to see a united Ireland and that "may as well happen now," appearing to endorse a move towards constitutional change on the island. This statement drew immediate criticism from the UK government and unionist leaders in Northern...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在访问爱尔兰共和国期间表示，他“乐见”爱尔兰统一，并认为“现在就发生也无妨”，似乎支持该岛的宪政变革。此番言论立即招致英国政府和北爱尔兰联合派领导人的批评。

body.en: US president says on visit to republic that unification will happen eventually so ‘may as well happen now’ Donald Trump has said he would “love” to see a united Ireland and that it “may as well happen now”. The US president appeared to endorse the push for constitutional change on the island at the start of a two-day visit to Ireland on Saturday. The unexpected intervention prompted a swift rebuttal from the UK government and Northern Ireland’s unionist leaders. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国总统在访问共和国时表示，统一最终会实现，所以“也可能现在就发生”唐纳德·特朗普表示，他“很高兴”看到一个统一的爱尔兰，而且“也可能现在就发生”。美国总统在周六开始对爱尔兰进行为期两天的访问时似乎支持推动岛上的宪法改革。这一意外的干预引发了英国政府和北爱尔兰工会领导人的迅速反驳。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the midst of complex political landscapes, statements about national identity and borders can stir deep emotions and historical currents. Matthew 5:9 calls us to be peacemakers, urging us to seek reconciliation and understanding even when discussing sensitive issues like national unification. May we pray for wisdom and a spirit of peace to guide leaders...
reflection.zh: 在复杂的政治格局中，关于国家认同和边界的言论会激起深刻的情感和历史潮流。《马太福音》5:9 呼吁我们成为和平之子，即使在讨论国家统一等敏感问题时，也要寻求和解与理解。愿我们祈求智慧与和平的精神，引导领袖和民众在探索这些深刻问题时都能如此行。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Number of UK anti-migrant vigilante groups surges in last 18 months
title.zh: 英国反移民的自发组织在过去18个月激增

summary.en: An exclusive investigation reveals that at least 28 anti-migrant vigilante groups have emerged in the UK over the past 18 months. These groups, ranging from unauthorized street patrols claiming to protect women and children to those harassing migrants and blocking ports, are raising concerns about potential disorder,...
summary.zh: 一项独家调查显示，在过去18个月里，英国至少出现了28个反移民的自发组织。这些组织形式多样，包括声称保护妇女儿童的未经授权的街头巡逻队，以及骚扰移民和封锁港口的团体。许多团体被指控以“社区保护”为幌子进行种族主义暴力活动，这引发了对可能发生混乱的担忧。

body.en: Exclusive: Many ‘use community protection as a cover for racist thuggery’, raising concerns about fresh disorder At least 28 anti-migrant vigilante groups have formed in the UK in the last 18 months, ranging from unauthorised street patrols claiming to protect women and children to groups harassing migrants in France and blocking ports. From Belfast to the south coast of England, the number of active groups has surged since the summer of 2025, according to analysis by the Guardian, amid widespread concerns over fresh disorder after black-clad vigilantes, many of them wearing balaclavas, blocked roads in Portsmouth and Dover last weekend. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：许多人“利用社区保护作为种族主义暴行的掩护”，引发了对新的骚乱的担忧过去18个月里，英国至少成立了28个反移民自卫团体，其中包括声称保护妇女和儿童的未经授权的街头巡逻队，以及骚扰法国移民和封锁港口的团体。据《卫报》分析，自 2025 年夏天以来，从贝尔法斯特到英格兰南海岸，活跃团体的数量激增，上周末朴茨茅斯和多佛的黑衣治安人员封锁了朴茨茅斯和多佛的道路，人们普遍担心新的骚乱。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rise of 28 anti-migrant vigilante groups in the UK, some engaging in 'racist thuggery,' highlights a dangerous cycle of escalating hostility. Jesus warned his followers, 'Put your sword back in its place... for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.' This principle serves as a stark reminder that violence begets violence, and those who resort to...
reflection.zh: 英国反移民自发组织的激增，其中一些团体参与“种族主义暴行”，凸显了一个危险的敌对升级循环。耶稣曾警告他的门徒：“收刀入鞘吧……因为凡动刀的，必死在刀下。”这一原则警示我们，暴力只会滋生暴力，诉诸武力者往往会自食其果。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Death toll from Philippines ferry fire rises to 76, with more still missing
title.zh: 菲律宾渡轮火灾死亡人数升至76人，仍有失踪者

summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard has recovered 41 bodies from the wreckage of a ferry that caught fire, bringing the total death toll to 76. The vessel was carrying over 130 people when the blaze erupted near Coron. Recovery efforts have been hampered by toxic fumes and lingering heat, with 13 people still unaccounted for.
summary.zh: 菲律宾海岸警卫队已从起火渡轮的残骸中打捞出41具遗体，使死亡总人数达到76人。该船载有130多人，当时在靠近科伦的地方发生火灾。有毒烟雾和持续的高温阻碍了遗体的搜寻工作，仍有13人下落不明。

body.en:
The Philippine Coast Guard says it has recovered 41 bodies from the wreckage of a ferry that caught fire this week, bringing the total death toll to 76.

More than 130 people were on board the MV June Aster when the blaze erupted on Wednesday as it neared its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron, after departing from Manila.

The coast guard said on Saturday the number of survivors remained 43, with many receiving treatment in hospital, but 13 people remain unaccounted for.

Recovery of bodies had been hampered due to toxic fumes and lingering heat, which meant authorities were unable to board until Friday.

Geronimo Tuvilla, an official for the Philippine Coast Guard, said the priority was identifying victims and determining the cause of the blaze.

Kristine Ablana, a tourism official in Coron, said relatives were being asked to help identify family members through personal items and DNA testing.

"Once someone is able to verify that this photo or these belongings are indeed those of their relative, they will be asked to provide a DNA sample," she said.

Coast Guard spokesperson Commodore Noemie Cayabyab said the fire began in a cargo hold before spreading.

She said survivors had described hearing a loud explosion, "the appearance of smoke and then fire. It spread very quickly". She added that those who had made it off the ship did not have time to put on lifejackets.

A survivor who was hauled to safety on a rescue boat told the BBC he had heard frantic cries onboard when the fire erupted, and was trampled by panicked people as he tried to escape.

The ferry, built in 2002, held valid safety certificates and passed an enforcement inspection in March, but investigators are looking into potential manifest discrepancies, cargo loading integrity, and crew emergency response protocols, the Palawan Daily reported.

Atienza Interisland Ferries, the vessel's operator, has pledged full co-operation with the inquiry.
body.zh: 菲律宾海岸警卫队表示，已从本周起火的一艘渡轮残骸中打捞出 41 具尸体，使总死亡人数达到 76 人。 周三，MV June Aster 从马尼拉出发，接近目的地旅游胜地科隆时发生火灾，船上有 130 多人。 海岸警卫队周六表示，幸存者仍有 43 人，其中许多人在医院接受治疗，但仍有 13 人下落不明。 由于有毒烟雾和挥之不去的高温，尸体的打捞工作受到阻碍，这意味着当局要到周五才能登机。 菲律宾海岸警卫队官员杰罗尼莫·图维拉 (Geronimo Tuvilla) 表示，当务之急是确认受害者身份并确定火灾原因。 科隆旅游官员克里斯汀·阿布拉纳 (Kristine Ablana) 表示，我们要求亲属通过个人物品和 DNA 检测来帮助识别家庭成员的身份。 她说：“一旦有人能够证实这张照片或这些物品确实是他们亲戚的，他们就会被要求提供 DNA 样本。” 海岸警卫队发言人诺埃米·卡亚比亚准将表示，火灾始于一个货舱，随后蔓延。 她说，幸存者描述听到一声巨大的爆炸声，“先是冒烟，然后起火。火势蔓延得非常快”。她补充说，那些从船上下来的人没有时间穿上救生衣。 一名被救生船救到安全地带的幸存者告诉英国广播公司，火灾爆发时，他听到船上传来疯狂的呼喊声，当他试图逃跑时，他被惊慌失措的人们践踏。 据《巴拉望日报》报道，这艘渡轮建于 2002 年，持有有效的安全证书，并于 3 月份通过了执法检查，但调查人员正在调查潜在的清单差异、货物装载完整性和船员应急响应协议。 该船的运营商 Atienza Interisland Ferries 已承诺全力配合调查。

reflection.en: The tragic fire on the MV June Aster, claiming 76 lives and leaving families in anguish, speaks to the deep human longing for an end to suffering. Revelation 21:4 offers a profound hope, promising a future where death, mourning, and pain will be no more. May this vision of ultimate restoration bring comfort to those grieving and a reminder of Yahweh's...
reflection.zh: MV June Aster渡轮上发生的悲惨火灾夺走了76人的生命，让家属们痛苦不堪，这触及了人类对终结苦难的深切渴望。《启示录》21:4 提供了深远的盼望，应许了一个不再有死亡、哀恸和痛苦的未来。愿这最终复兴的景象能安慰那些哀痛的人们，并提醒我们雅伟最终将战胜一切悲剧。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Trump visits Ireland, says unification would be 'fantastic'
title.zh: 特朗普访问爱尔兰，称统一将是“极好的”

summary.en: US President Donald Trump's trip to Ireland to watch a golf tournament has also included meetings with leaders there. During his visit, Trump expressed his desire to see the Republic of Ireland unite with British-run Northern Ireland.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普前往爱尔兰观看高尔夫比赛的行程中，还包括与当地领导人的会晤。在访问期间，特朗普表达了他希望看到爱尔兰共和国与英国统治下的北爱尔兰统一的愿望。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump's trip to Ireland to watch a golf tournament has also included meetings with leaders there.

US President Donald Trump has said he would "love" to see the Republic of Ireland , an EU member, unite with British-run ⁠Northern Ireland as he faced reporters' questions on a range of issues on Saturday.

Trump is taking the weekend trip largely to watch the Irish Open golf tournament held on a course he owns on the country’s Atlantic coast, but he met as well with the Irish president and prime minister, or taoiseach.

The US leader also spoke optimistically about his country's war with Iran and its trade conflict with Canada , among several other topics.

After a meeting with Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin in the capital, Dublin, Trump said he very much supported what he said would be the eventual unification of the two parts of the island of Ireland.

"Well, I don't want to ​cause any problems, ​but ‌I will tell you, I'd love to see ‌it unified," Trump told ‌reporters.

"The way I look at it, it's ⁠going ​to happen ​eventually ... I think it would ​be a ‌fantastic thing," he added.

"Now the UK will have ​something ⁠to say about it ... but ⁠I think ​it would be a great thing."

The British government responded swiftly to the remarks, with Prime Minister Andy Burham's office saying that in his view, there was no majority public support for a referendum on the issue and that there would not be another one until that changed. 

Previous US presidents have avoided touching on the subject in view of the delicate nature of the issue, with Northern Ireland seeing decades of of deadly sectarian violence in the 20th century over the question of whom it should belong to.

Trump also said that the US war with Iran, which began on February 28, would "end very soon" — a view he has frequently expressed in the past, but which has not yet materialized.

He also said that the end of the conflict would mean that the price of oil, which has soared as a result of the war, would "come tumbling down."

However, he vehemently defended his decision to mount the military operation against Iran.

He said that the US attacked because "Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon", adding: "They were two weeks away from having a nuclear weapon."

"If they had it, they would have blown up Israel, they would have blown up the Middle East, and they would have hit some [...] in my opinion, [of] Europe's cities and beyond cities, and they would probably hit us soon before we put out the fire. But they cannot have a nuclear weapon."

The war with Iran is not supported by a majority of the US population, particularly in view of promises made by Trump on the campaign trail to keep his country out of foreign...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普前往爱尔兰观看高尔夫锦标赛的行程还包括与当地领导人的会面。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在周六就一系列问题接受记者提问时表示，他“乐意”看到欧盟成员国爱尔兰共和国与英国管理的北爱尔兰团结起来。 特朗普周末旅行主要是为了观看在该国大西洋海岸他拥有的球场上举行的爱尔兰高尔夫公开赛，但他也会见了爱尔兰总统和总理（或称爱尔兰总理）。 这位美国领导人还乐观地谈到了美国与伊朗的战争以及与加拿大的贸易冲突等几个话题。 在首都都柏林与爱尔兰总理迈克尔·马丁会面后，特朗普表示，他非常支持他所说的爱尔兰岛两部分的最终统一。 “好吧，我不想造成任何问题，但我会告诉你，我很乐意看到它统一，”特朗普告诉记者。 “在我看来，这最终会发生……我认为这将是一件奇妙的事情，”他补充道。 “现在英国对此有话要说……但我认为这将是一件伟大的事情。” 英国政府迅速回应了这一言论，首相安迪·伯勒姆的办公室表示，在他看来，没有大多数公众支持就此问题举行公投，并且在情况改变之前不会再举行公投。 鉴于该问题的微妙性质，历任美国总统都避免触及这一主题，北爱尔兰在 20 世纪因归属问题而发生了数十年致命的宗派暴力。 特朗普还表示，2月28日开始的美国与伊朗的战争将“很快结束”——这是他过去经常表达的观点，但尚未实现。 他还表示，冲突的结束将意味着因战争而飙升的石油价格将“暴跌”。 然而，他强烈捍卫自己对伊朗采取军事行动的决定。 他说，美国发动袭击是因为“伊朗无法拥有核武器”，并补充道：“他们距离拥有核武器还有两周的时间。” “如果他们拥有的话，他们会炸毁以色列，他们会炸毁中东，他们会袭击一些……在我看来，欧洲的城市和其他城市，他们可能会在我们扑灭大火之前不久袭击我们。但他们不可能拥有核武器。” 与伊朗的战争并没有得到大多数美国民众的支持，特别是考虑到特朗普在竞选过程中做出的让他的国家远离外国的承诺……

reflection.en: During his visit to Ireland, President Trump voiced his support for the unification of the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland. This statement, made amidst a golf tournament, touches upon the long-standing political aspirations and complexities of the region. The pursuit of peace and reconciliation often involves navigating deeply rooted historical and...
reflection.zh: 在访问爱尔兰期间，特朗普总统表达了他对爱尔兰共和国与北爱尔兰统一的支持。这一声明是在高尔夫比赛期间发表的，触及了该地区长期存在的政治愿望和复杂性。追求和平与和解往往需要驾驭根深蒂固的历史和政治格局，这是一个需要所有相关方耐心和理解的过程。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: The US's "extremely frank" conversations with Putin and Zelensky
title.zh: 美俄乌领导人会晤的“极其坦诚”对话

summary.en: The US, as the host country for the G20, is actively working to arrange a meeting between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to de-escalate the conflict.
summary.zh: 作为G20的东道主，美国正积极促成俄罗斯总统普京与乌克兰总统泽连斯基的会晤，以缓和冲突。

body.en:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he would be willing to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at a G20 summit in December, in an interview released Saturday, as efforts intensify to end the conflict.

The US is seeking to kick-start long-stalled negotiations to find a solution to the conflict, Europe's deadliest since World War II, with US negotiators recently visiting Kyiv and Moscow and President Donald Trump and Putin this week holding talks on the conflict over the phone.

The US holds this year's presidency of the Group of 20 major economies, which comprises 19 countries plus the European Union and the African Union, and culminates in a leaders' summit in Miami in December.

Russia's finance minister has already attended one G20 meeting, causing discomfort among some of Ukraine's allies, and a Russian diplomat said Saturday that Moscow will also send some officials to a G20 energy meeting in Houston next week.

Asked whether he would be willing to meet Putin at the December summit if both leaders were invited, Zelensky told German broadcaster Deutsche Welle: "Yes, of course.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"It's not about words. What I will tell him or what he wants to tell me, it doesn't matter. It doesn't matter. Matters only result. Result matters. That's it."

Last weekend, US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visited Moscow and Putin and Trump also discussed the war earlier in the week in what the Kremlin termed an "extremely frank" and constructive hour-long phone call.

In the Deutsche Welle interview, which took place Friday in Canada, Zelensky said that Witkoff and Kushner's visit was a "good signal", and it was important the pair had visited Kyiv as well as Moscow.

Zelensky has also announced he plans to meet Trump in late September, as the US pushes for fresh face-to-face talks between Moscow and Kyiv.

Asked about Ukraine's position ahead of possible negotiations, Zelensky responded: "Ukraine now is much more stronger than last year on the battlefield."

Russia was sustaining heavy battlefield losses, paying a "big price" for "very slow moves on the battlefield," he said.

Ukraine has said the talks could happen as early as this month, but Russia on Monday said it was "too early" to discuss a venue or dates.

Several previous rounds of negotiations have failed. Trust between the sides is low, and there is no sign that Russia or Ukraine have shifted their positions.

Both countries have escalated long-range strikes on each other in recent months, leading to the highest civilian death toll since the early days of the war.

Zelensky also repeated his call for Ukraine's allies to provide more interceptor...
body.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基在周六发布的采访中表示，随着结束冲突的努力加紧，他愿意在 12 月的 G20 峰会上会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京。 美国正在寻求启动长期停滞的谈判，以找到解决这场二战以来欧洲最严重的冲突的方案，美国谈判代表最近访问了基辅和莫斯科，唐纳德·特朗普总统和普京本周就冲突进行了电话会谈。 美国担任今年二十国集团主要经济体主席国，该集团由 19 个国家以及欧盟和非洲联盟组成，最终将于 12 月在迈阿密举行领导人峰会。 俄罗斯财政部长已经出席了一次G20会议，引起乌克兰一些盟友的不安，一名俄罗斯外交官周六表示，莫斯科还将派一些官员参加下周在休斯敦举行的G20能源会议。 当被问及如果两位领导人都受到邀请，他是否愿意在 12 月峰会上与普京会面时，泽伦斯基告诉德国广播公司德国之声：“是的，当然。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “这不是言语的问题。我会告诉他什么或者他想告诉我什么，并不重要。没关系。事情只有结果。结果很重要。就是这样。” 上周末，美国谈判代表史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳访问了莫斯科，普京和特朗普也在本周早些时候讨论了这场战争，克里姆林宫称这是一次“极其坦诚”和建设性的长达一小时的电话。 泽连斯基周五在加拿大接受德国之声采访时表示，威特科夫和库什纳的访问是一个“好信号”，两人访问基辅和莫斯科很重要。 泽伦斯基还宣布，他计划在 9 月下旬会见特朗普，因为美国正在推动莫斯科和基辅之间进行新的面对面会谈。 当被问及乌克兰在可能的谈判之前的立场时，泽伦斯基回答说：“乌克兰现在在战场上比去年强大得多。” 他说，俄罗斯在战场上损失惨重，为“战场行动非常缓慢”付出了“巨大代价”。 乌克兰表示，会谈最早可能在本月举行，但俄罗斯周一表示，讨论地点或日期“还为时过早”。 此前的几轮谈判均以失败告终。双方之间的信任度很低，而且没有迹象表明俄罗斯或乌克兰已经改变立场。 近几个月来，两国都升级了对对方的远程打击，导致平民死亡人数达到战争初期以来的最高水平。 泽连斯基还再次呼吁乌克兰盟友提供更多拦截弹……

reflection.en: In the midst of Europe's deadliest conflict since World War II, the US is engaging in "extremely frank" conversations, seeking to bring Presidents Putin and Zelensky together at the G20 summit. This diplomatic effort embodies the Beatitude, "Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God."
reflection.zh: 在欧洲自二战以来最致命的冲突中，美国正进行“极其坦诚”的对话，试图在G20峰会上促成普京总统与泽连斯基总统的会晤。这一外交努力体现了“使人和睦的人有福了，因为人要称他们为神的儿子”的八福。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Corals as climate archive: Are El Ninos intensifying?
title.zh: 珊瑚作为气候档案：厄尔尼诺现象是否正在加剧？

summary.en: Records from recent decades indicate that El Nino events have been frequent and often extreme. This story explores whether this pattern is normal or a consequence of climate change, using coral records as a key indicator.
summary.zh: 近几十年的记录表明，厄尔尼诺现象频繁且常常极端。这个故事探讨这种模式是正常的还是气候变化的后果，并以珊瑚记录作为关键指标。

body.en:
Records from the past few decades show that, during this period, El Nino events have been frequent and often extreme. But is this normal, or is it the result of climate change? Corals can give us a clear indication.

A storm is gathering. Most likely a very big one. El Nino is a natural climate phenomenon occurring every two to seven years, towards the end of the year, but it comes in various different strengths, depending on the prevailing conditions.

El Ninos are considered strong if the surface temperature of the water off the west coast of South America is more than 1.5 degrees Celsius above average. In July this year, the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) was already observing temperature increases of greater than three degrees Celsius in the eastern and central Pacific.

The German Meteorological Service believes this "could in all likelihood develop into one of the strongest El Nino events since records began."

But a recent article by the Max Planck Institute for Meteorology states that whether or not strong El Nino events will intensify as a result of climate change "remains the subject of ongoing research."

The problem is that the data on ocean surface temperatures is only truly reliable from the 1980s onward, with the start of satellite observation. And this data doesn't tell us how El Nino behaved before industrialization and the burning of fossil fuels.

US researchers say corals can help to close this knowledge gap. Julia Cole, a climate scientist and paleoclimatologist at the University of Michigan, and her team recently  published a study  on this subject in the journal Science .

"We've known for a long time that the last 40 or 50 years has really strong El Nino events," says Cole. "It's been hard to say whether the recent strong El Nino that we've had is part of a natural cycle, or if it's something a little bit unusual related to being in a warmer than normal world." The coral analysis points firmly in one direction: Unusual. Not normal.

Cole and her team examined fossilized and living corals around the Galapagos Islands off Ecuador in the eastern Pacific. Corals grow between one and two centimeters per year, and in doing so form a structure similar to growth rings on trees. "We made use of the fact that corals record ocean temperatures as they grow, in the chemical composition of their skeleton," Cole explains.

Corals are living creatures that construct external skeletons through calcification, adding a band of new growth each year with calcium carbonate precipitated from the surrounding water. In this way, over decades and centuries, corals have formed entire reef systems. Other chemical elements are also incorporated into the skeleton during the calcification process — strontium, for...
body.zh: 过去几十年的记录表明，这一时期厄尔尼诺现象频繁且极端。但这是正常现象还是气候变化的结果？珊瑚可以给我们一个明确的指示。 一场风暴正在聚集。很可能是一个非常大的。厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然气候现象，每两到七年在年底发生一次，但根据当时的情况，它有各种不同的强度。 如果南美洲西海岸附近的海水表面温度比平均水平高出 1.5 摄氏度以上，则厄尔尼诺现象被视为强厄尔尼诺现象。今年7月，美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）已经观察到东太平洋和中太平洋气温上升超过3摄氏度。 德国气象局认为，这“很可能发展成为有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺事件之一”。 但马克斯·普朗克气象研究所最近发​​表的一篇文章指出，强烈的厄尔尼诺事件是否会因气候变化而加剧“仍然是正在进行的研究的主题”。 问题在于，海洋表面温度的数据只有在 20 世纪 80 年代卫星观测开始后才真正可靠。这些数据并没有告诉我们厄尔尼诺现象在工业化和化石燃料燃烧之前的表现如何。 美国研究人员表示，珊瑚可以帮助缩小这一知识差距。密歇根大学的气候科学家和古气候学家朱莉娅·科尔 (Julia Cole) 和她的团队最近在《科学》杂志上发表了一项关于这一主题的研究。 “我们很早就知道，过去 40 或 50 年发生了非常强烈的厄尔尼诺事件，”科尔说。 “很难说最近发生的强烈厄尔尼诺现象是否是自然循环的一部分，或者是否与世界比正常温暖有关，有些不寻常。”珊瑚分析坚定地指向一个方向：不寻常。不正常。 科尔和她的团队检查了东太平洋厄瓜多尔附近的加拉帕戈斯群岛周围的化石和活珊瑚。珊瑚每年生长一到两厘米，并在此过程中形成类似于树木年轮的结构。 “我们利用了珊瑚在生长过程中通过其骨骼的化学成分记录海洋温度的事实，”科尔解释道。 珊瑚是通过钙化构建外部骨骼的生物，每年都会利用周围水中沉淀的碳酸钙增加新的生长带。就这样，经过几十年和几个世纪，珊瑚形成了完整的珊瑚礁系统。在钙化过程中，其他化学元素也会融入骨骼中——锶，用于......

reflection.en: The intricate coral records reveal a planet under stress, with El Nino events intensifying. As we observe these changes, we are reminded that the Earth and all its inhabitants are the creation of Yahweh. This understanding calls us to be faithful stewards of the world entrusted to us, caring for its delicate ecosystems.
reflection.zh: 复杂的珊瑚记录揭示了一个承受压力的星球，厄尔尼诺现象日益加剧。当我们观察到这些变化时，我们被提醒，地和其中万物都属于雅伟。这一认识呼吁我们成为受托管理的世界的忠实管家，关爱其脆弱的生态系统。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Uber leaves two key African markets — and their drivers in despair
title.zh: 优步退出非洲两大市场——将其司机留在了绝望之中

summary.en: Uber's withdrawal from Nigeria and Uganda has left many drivers in a difficult situation. With increasing costs for fuel and maintenance, drivers are finding it hard to earn a living, especially after the company's unexpected exit from these markets.
summary.zh: 优步退出尼日利亚和乌干达市场，使得许多司机陷入困境。随着燃油和维修成本的不断上涨，司机们在公司意外退出这些市场后，发现维持生计变得异常艰难。

body.en:
Uber's departure from Nigeria and Uganda has left countless customers high and dry. But what about drivers? With fuel prices, maintenance, and other operating costs rising, many say they're struggling to make a living.

A week ago, Uber unexpectedly announced its departure from the Nigerian market after spending more than a decade building up its presence in Africa's most populous country. The ride-hailing platform also said it would be winding up its operations in Uganda — also with immediate effect.

With the exit from both Nigeria and Uganda , Uber now remains operational only in a handful of African countries — Egypt, Ghana, Kenya, and South Africa.

"This decision is limited strictly to these two markets and does not impact our operations across the rest of the continent," Uber said in a statement, adding that their "immediate priority is supporting drivers, riders, and local team members throughout this transition," without sharing details on what this assistance would entail.

In the last year, the multinational company also closed shop in Ivory Coast and Tanzania, while also cutting its global workforce by 10%.

Uber has not managed to grow across much of the African market despite its massive global scale. The profit-driven ride-hailing app faces stiff competition from rival platforms, including Bolt, inDrive and SafeBoda, which operate in the Nigerian and Ugandan markets and beyond.

However, it's not only Uber that is having to deal with its frustration over the current situation: Many of its drivers across Africa have been raising complaints about shrinking profit margins amid rising fuel costs, inflation and currency volatility, especially in markets like Nigeria.

In their view, Uber's business model of pocketing around 20% — 25% of any trip fare in commissions is no longer tenable.

Abbas Olamide, an Uber driver in the Nigerian capital Abuja, said the company's overall service was "good," while firmly stressing that the high commission rates were adding greatly to his existing woes .

He told DW that a ride of 30,000 Naira (€20) "to the airport means the ride-hailing app would deduct 6,000 Naira as commission," still leaving him to "then pay a gate fee at the airport."

"Probably because you do not want to go back to town empty-handed, we also pay to park at the airport [to pick up another client]," he explained.

Samuel Olatunji, an Uber-driver in the megacity Lagos, also shared his concerns with DW following the abrupt announcement of Uber's exit, saying he will now have to recalibrate his own business model.

The 43-year-old driver says he'll have to join hundreds of other drivers who "have to depend on other [ride-hailing] apps now" to ensure any steady stream of income.

In recent years, drivers like Olamide...
body.zh: Uber退出尼日利亚和乌干达让无数客户陷入困境。但司机呢？随着燃料价格、维护和其他运营成本的上涨，许多人表示他们正在为生计而苦苦挣扎。 一周前，优步出人意料地宣布退出尼日利亚市场，此前该公司花了十多年时间在非洲人口最多的国家建立了业务。该叫车平台还表示将结束在乌干达的业务，并立即生效。 随着尼日利亚和乌干达的退出，优步现在只在少数非洲国家继续运营——埃及、加纳、肯尼亚和南非。 优步在一份声明中表示：“这一决定严格限于这两个市场，不会影响我们在非洲大陆其他地区的运营。”并补充说，他们的“当务之急是在整个过渡过程中为司机、乘客和当地团队成员提供支持”，但没有透露这项援助所需的详细信息。 去年，这家跨国公司还关闭了在科特迪瓦和坦桑尼亚的工厂，同时还削减了 10% 的全球员工。 尽管优步在全球规模庞大，但未能在非洲大部分市场实现增长。这款以利润为导向的叫车应用程序面临着来自竞争对手平台的激烈竞争，包括在尼日利亚和乌干达等市场运营的 Bolt、inDrive 和 SafeBoda。 然而，不仅仅是优步必须应对当前形势的沮丧：非洲各地的许多司机都在抱怨燃油成本上涨、通货膨胀和货币波动导致利润率下降，尤其是在尼日利亚等市场。 在他们看来，Uber 将出行费用的 20% 至 25% 左右作为佣金的商业模式已经站不住脚了。 尼日利亚首都阿布贾的优步司机阿巴斯·奥拉米德表示，该公司的整体服务“良好”，同时坚定地强调，高额佣金大大加剧了他现有的困境。 他告诉德国之声，前往机场的乘车费用为 30,000 奈拉（20 欧元），“意味着叫车应用程序将扣除 6,000 奈拉作为佣金”，但他仍然“需要在机场支付登机费”。 “可能是因为你不想空手回城，我们还支付在机场停车的费用（以接另一位客户），”他解释道。 在Uber突然宣布退出后，特大城市拉各斯的Uber司机塞缪尔·奥拉通吉(Samuel Olatunji)也向德国之声表达了他的担忧，称他现在必须重新调整自己的商业模式。 这位 43 岁的司机表示，他将不得不加入数百名其他司机的行列，“现在必须依赖其他[叫车]应用程序”来确保稳定的收入来源。 近年来，像奥拉米德这样的车手...

reflection.en: The departure of Uber from Nigeria and Uganda leaves many drivers in a precarious economic situation. James's words in chapter 5 speak powerfully to the plight of workers whose wages are withheld or whose livelihoods are disrupted by corporate decisions. This situation calls for empathy and a consideration of the human cost behind business strategies.
reflection.zh: 优步退出尼日利亚和乌干达，使许多司机陷入了经济困境。雅各书第五章的话语有力地道出了工人们的困境，他们的工资被拖欠，或者他们的生计因公司的决定而中断。这种情况呼唤着同情心，并需要我们考虑商业策略背后的人力成本。

verse.textEn: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workers who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of Yahweh Almighty.
verse.textZh: 工人给你们收割庄稼，你们亏欠他们的工钱，这工钱有声音呼叫，并且那收割之人的冤声已经入了万军之主的耳了。

title.en: Australians love traveling to the UK. They could soon be paying more
title.zh: 英国人喜爱前往英国旅行。他们可能很快就要支付更多费用了

summary.en: The UK government is moving ahead with a controversial levy, the 'Overnight Visitor Levy,' which will allow regional mayors to charge a percentage on accommodation stays. Prime Minister Andy Burnham hopes this tax will help shift power and money away from London, with the 1.2 million Australians who visit the UK...
summary.zh: 英国政府正着手实施一项有争议的收费项目——“过夜游客税”，该项目将允许地区市长按比例收取住宿费用。安迪·伯纳姆首相希望这项税收能帮助将权力和资金从伦敦转移出去，每年访问英国的120万澳大利亚游客可能会面临更高的费用。

body.en:
The bill is about to get steeper for the 1.2 million Australians who travel to the UK every year as British mayors will soon have the power to charge a so-called "tourist tax" on accommodation.

Last week the UK government announced it was going to be pressing ahead with the controversial levy which Prime Minister Andy Burnham — the so called "King of the North" — hopes will help move power and money way from London.

Called the "Overnight Visitor Levy," it gives regional mayors the option to tax people on a percentage of their stays at hotels, bed and breakfasts and other types of accommodation.

Burnham— who replaced Keir Starmer as prime minister in July— sees the levy as a way of financially empowering regional cities.

He said last week the tax would come into force towards the end of the next financial year, with mayors expected to set out spending plans for the funds raised by early 2028.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The levy will be set at the discretion of city councils but on Friday Labour mayors in 10 regional cities said they would cap the charge the charge at five per cent, following widespread concerns from the hospitality industry that the levy would dampen spending.

An exact date for the levy's introduction has not been announced but Burnham said the tax would come into force towards the end of next financial year and apply to both Britons and international tourists.

The exact terms of the levy could vary from city to city, but mayors in London, Greater Manchester, Liverpool City Region, West Midlands, North East, West of England, West Yorkshire, South Yorkshire, East Midlands and York and North Yorkshire have all agreed to the five per cent cap.

Two Reform UK mayors and two Conservative party mayors have said they would oppose any levy — so its possible the price of accommodation will go up in some cities, but not others.

While the five per cent levy would be new for regional cities in Britain, it's not a UK first.

In July, Edinburgh launched a 5 per cent levy on accommodation that's capped at five nights and similar taxes are already common around the world.

New York, LA, Brussels, Amsterdam, Toronto and Montreal all have their own equivalent charges.

Wales is set to introduce it's own £1.30 per person per night levy in April of next year.

The move has not been supported by UKHospitality, which represents the sector. It said the move would hurt British families and add to red tape.

"Give mayors one tax-raising power on one sector and they will pull that lever until it snaps," said Chief Executive Allen Simpson.

Simpson cited research by consultancy Oxford Economics estimating...
body.zh: 由于英国市长很快将有权对住宿征收所谓的“旅游税”，因此每年前往英国旅游的 120 万澳大利亚人的账单将变得更加昂贵。 上周，英国政府宣布将推进有争议的征税，被称为“北方之王”的首相安迪·伯纳姆希望此举有助于将权力和金钱从伦敦转移出去。 它被称为“过夜游客税”，它让地区市长可以选择对人们在酒店、住宿加早餐和其他类型住宿的住宿比例征税。 伯纳姆于 7 月接替凯尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 出任总理，他认为征税是增强地区城市财政实力的一种方式。 他上周表示，该税收将在下一个财政年度结束时生效，预计市长们将制定 2028 年初筹集资金的支出计划。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 征税将由市议会自行决定，但周五，10 个地区城市的工党市长表示，由于酒店业普遍担心征税会抑制支出，他们将把收费上限限制在 5%。 征收该税的具体日期尚未公布，但伯纳姆表示，该税将于下财年末生效，适用于英国人和国际游客。 征税的具体条款可能因城市而异，但伦敦、大曼彻斯特、利物浦城市地区、西米德兰兹、东北部、英格兰西部、西约克郡、南约克郡、东米德兰兹以及约克和北约克郡的市长都同意5%的上限。 两位英国改革派市长和两位保守党市长表示，他们反对任何征税——因此，一些城市的住宿价格可能会上涨，但其他城市则不会。 虽然百分之五的征税对于英国地区城市来说是新举措，但这并不是英国首创。 7月，爱丁堡对住宿征收5%的税，上限为五晚，类似的税收在世界各地已经很常见。 纽约、洛杉矶、布鲁塞尔、阿姆斯特丹、多伦多和蒙特利尔都有各自的同等费用。 威尔士将于明年 4 月推出每人每晚 1.30 英镑的税收。 此举并未得到代表该行业的英国酒店业协会的支持。它表示此举将伤害英国家庭并增加繁文缛节。 首席执行官艾伦·辛普森 (Allen Simpson) 表示：“赋予市长对某个行业增税的权力，他们就会拉动杠杆，直到杠杆断裂为止。” 辛普森引用了牛津经济咨询公司的研究估计……

reflection.en: The proposal for an 'Overnight Visitor Levy' in the UK highlights how local leaders seek to fund public services and regional development. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds us that rulers are called to 'execute justice and righteousness' and 'deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence.' This principle calls leaders to consider the impact of their...
reflection.zh: 英国提议征收“过夜游客税”，这凸显了地方领导人如何寻求为公共服务和区域发展提供资金。《耶利米书》22章3节提醒我们，统治者被呼召要“施行公平和公义”，并“从欺压者的手中拯救那受欺压的”。这一原则呼吁领导人考虑其财政决策对所有人的影响，确保政策服务于共同利益，并且不会给游客或居民带来不当负担。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Russia's drone war comes to Moldova and Romania
title.zh: 俄罗斯的无人机战争蔓延至摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚

summary.en: Russian drone incursions into the airspace of Moldova and Romania are becoming more frequent. This week, the Ukrainian president's plane was prevented from taking off from Chisinau. Observers suspect these incursions are intentional.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯无人机侵入摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚领空的事件日益频繁。本周，乌克兰总统的飞机在基希讷乌被阻止起飞。观察家们怀疑这些入侵是故意的。

body.en:
Incursions by Russian drones into Moldovan and Romanian airspace are increasingly common. This week the Ukrainian president's plane was stopped from taking off from Chisinau. Observers suspect the attacks are deliberate.

For Ukrainians, Russia's air war has been a bitter, bloody reality for years. People in Ukraine are being  killed every day by missiles, bombs, and drones . But the country's central and southeastern European neighbors have also found themselves affected, albeit on a smaller scale: Missiles and drones sometimes invade their air space, and occasionally even crash on their territory.

Now the Russian drone war is coming dangerously close to two of Ukraine's neighbors: Romania and the Republic of Moldova , where drone incidents are now an almost daily occurrence. The drones often explode, leaving people injured, and there have also been recent attacks on Ukrainian checkpoints at the Moldovan and Romanian borders.

The attacks have now escalated to such a degree that many observers believe they can no longer be considered unintentional. They suspect the Kremlin is deliberately trying to bring the war to Ukraine's neighbors.

The latest drone incursion and crash on Tuesday caused a furore as it prevented a plane with the Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on board from taking off in the Moldovan capital Chisinau. A Russian Geran drone, which can fly as fast as 500 kilometers per hour (311 mph), took off in Crimea, then flew through Ukrainian airspace and eventually crashed in a sunflower field near the Moldovan city of Riscani.

The drone also flew over Romania, where two fighter jets were scrambled from NATO's Kogalniceanu airbase near the Black Sea port of Constanta, though it remains unclear why they did not shoot down the drone, as they had on other occasions.

The most serious aspect of the incident was that it showed how limited Moldovan air defense is in its ability to protect the country's air space. The drones were detected and tracked by air traffic control, but it was not possible to shoot them down. According to publicly available information, the country possesses only a small number of Polish Piorun anti-aircraft missiles, and these are only able to protect certain specific targets.

There have been around three dozen drone incidents in Romania and Moldova since the beginning of August this year. The majority were airspace violations, but there have also been crashes and explosions, while debris has also been found. In Romania, several drones have also been shot down. According to official data, 17 drones crashed in August in Moldova alone – as many as in all of 2025.

There was also a drone strike on the Starokozache border crossing between Ukraine and southeastern...
body.zh: 俄罗斯无人机入侵摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚领空的情况越来越普遍。本周，乌克兰总统的专机被阻止从基希讷乌起飞。观察人士怀疑这些袭击是故意的。 对于乌克兰人来说，俄罗斯的空战多年来一直是痛苦而血腥的现实。乌克兰每天都有人被导弹、炸弹和无人机杀害。但该国的中欧和东南欧邻国也发现自己受到了影响，尽管规模较小：导弹和无人机有时会侵入其领空，有时甚至坠毁在其领土上。 现在，俄罗斯无人机战争正危险地逼近乌克兰的两个邻国：罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦共和国，这两个国家几乎每天都会发生无人机事件。无人机经常爆炸，造成人员受伤，最近摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚边境的乌克兰检查站也发生了袭击事件。 现在，袭击已经升级到了如此程度，以至于许多观察家认为这些袭击不能再被认为是无意的。他们怀疑克里姆林宫故意试图将战争带到乌克兰的邻国。 周二最新的无人机入侵和坠机事件引起了轩然大波，因为它阻止了载有乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基的一架飞机在摩尔多瓦首都基希讷乌起飞。一架俄罗斯Geran无人机的飞行速度可达每小时500公里（311英里/小时），从克里米亚起飞，然后飞越乌克兰领空，最终坠毁在摩尔多瓦城市里斯卡尼附近的向日葵田里。 这架无人机还飞越了罗马尼亚上空，两架战斗机从黑海康斯坦察港附近的北约科加尔尼恰努空军基地起飞，不过目前还不清楚为什么他们没有像其他场合那样击落这架无人机。 该事件最严重的方面是，它表明摩尔多瓦防空部队保护该国领空的能力是多么有限。空中交通管制发现并跟踪了这些无人机，但无法将其击落。根据公开信息，波兰仅拥有少量皮奥伦防空导弹，且只能保护某些特定目标。 自今年八月初以来，罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦已发生约三打无人机事件。大多数都是侵犯领空的事件，但也发生过坠机和爆炸事件，同时也发现了碎片。 在罗马尼亚，也有几架无人机被击落。根据官方数据，8 月份仅摩尔多瓦就有 17 架无人机坠毁，这一数字是 2025 年全年的总数量。 乌克兰和东南部之间的斯塔科扎切边境口岸也遭到无人机袭击。

reflection.en: The increasing presence of Russian drones over Moldova and Romania instills fear and uncertainty, disrupting the peace of these neighboring nations. In times of such geopolitical tension and potential threat, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that God remains our ultimate refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble. Even as the world experiences turmoil, we...
reflection.zh: 俄罗斯无人机在摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚上空日益增多的存在，带来了恐惧和不确定性，扰乱了这些邻国的和平。在这样的地缘政治紧张和潜在威胁时期，《诗篇》46:1提醒我们，雅伟是我们最终的避难所和力量，是在患难中随时的帮助。即使世界经历动荡，我们也能在他同在中找到安慰和稳定。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: How Trump used 9/11 to make the case for war with Iran
title.zh: 特朗普如何利用9/11来为对伊朗开战制造理由

summary.en: President Donald Trump utilized a 9/11 memorial ceremony to link the "War on Terror" to the ongoing conflict with Iran and to bolster support for upcoming midterm elections, despite his approval ratings being near historic lows.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统利用9/11纪念仪式，将“反恐战争”与持续进行的与伊朗的冲突联系起来，并为即将到来的中期选举争取支持，尽管他的支持率接近历史低点。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has used a memorial ceremony marking the 25th anniversary of 9/11 to draw a direct line between the "War on Terror" that followed the terrorist attacks and the on-going US-Israeli war on Iran.

In an unusual move, Trump paid his respects at the Pentagon rather than attending the main ceremony in New York, where two hijacked planes struck the Twin Towers at the World Trade Centre in a series of attacks that killed 2,977 people September 11, 2001.

He used the same event to also touch on election conspiracy claims and a controversial midterm proposal, as Trump's approval rating sits near historic lows just two months out from the elections.

In his Pentagon address, Trump drew parallels between the September 11 attack and the US' deeply unpopular war in Iran.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Today we renew the sacred oath that we first swore in their names a quarter of a century ago. We will never, ever forget," Trump said. "That’s why we fight today."

"We don’t have a choice. There can only be victory. We fight hard. We fight to win."

He drew links between the fight against Al-Qaeda — launched by his Republican predecessor George W. Bush after the attacks — and the ongoing US-Israeli war against Iran, now in its seventh month.

"Today we salute every member of the United States military who served in the 'war on terror'," he said.

"And we salute the service members working right now to ensure the world’s number one sponsor of terror, the Islamic Republic of Iran, will never ever have a nuclear weapon."

US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth used his own remarks at the ceremony to boast about the US' success in the war.

"Over the past six months, we have laid waste to the world's most prolific state sponsor of terrorism. Our warriors have fought an Islamic theocracy that has wished us death for nearly half a century," Hegseth said.

“We’re still sending terrorists where they belong, to hell, and tankers to the bottom of the ocean where they belong. And we’re ensuring that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon."

Hegseth claimed the US had destroyed Iran's defences and controlled the Strait of Hormuz, adding that "economic pressure tightens every day" and the US "will finish this fight".

The Iran war has slid into a stalemate with Iran largely maintaining its grip on the Strait of Hormuz, and keeping oil prices high, despite sporadic exchanges of fire with the US.

Trump also used his speech to take aim at domestic political opponents, calling them "fanatics".

Telling the story of a firefighter killed in the attacks whose son went on to become a US Navy veteran,...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普利用纪念9/11 25周年的纪念仪式，在恐怖袭击之后的“反恐战争”与正在进行的美以对伊朗战争之间划清了界限。 特朗普没有参加在纽约举行的主仪式，而是在五角大楼表达了敬意，这是一个不同寻常的举动。2001年9月11日，两架被劫持的飞机袭击了世贸中心双子塔，引发了一系列袭击，造成2,977人死亡。 他利用同一事件还谈到了选举阴谋论和有争议的中期提案，因为距离选举仅两个月，特朗普的支持率就接近历史低点。 特朗普在五角大楼讲话中将 9 月 11 日的袭击与美国极不受欢迎的伊朗战争进行了类比。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “今天，我们重申四分之一世纪前我们首次以他们的名义宣誓的神圣誓言。我们永远、永远不会忘记，”特朗普说。 “这就是我们今天战斗的原因。” “我们别无选择。只有胜利。我们努力战斗。我们为胜利而战。” 他将打击基地组织的斗争（由他的共和党前任乔治·W·布什在袭击事件后发起）与正在进行的美以针对伊朗的战争联系起来，该战争现已进入第七个月。 “今天，我们向每一位参与‘反恐战争’的美国军人致敬，”他说。 “我们向目前正在努力确保世界头号恐怖主义赞助者伊朗伊斯兰共和国永远不会拥有核武器的军人致敬。” 美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯在仪式上发表讲话，吹嘘美国在战争中取得的成功。 赫格斯说：“在过去的六个月里，我们摧毁了世界上最多产的恐怖主义国家支持者。我们的战士一直在与伊斯兰神权政权作斗争，而这个政权在近半个世纪的时间里一直在与我们作斗争。” “我们仍在将恐怖分子送入他们所属的地方，将油轮送至他们所属的海底。我们还要确保伊朗永远不会拥有核武器。” 赫格斯声称美国摧毁了伊朗的防御并控制了霍尔木兹海峡，并补充说“经济压力每天都在收紧”，美国“将结束这场战斗”。 伊朗战争已陷入僵局，尽管伊朗与美国发生了零星交火，但伊朗基本上维持了对霍尔木兹海峡的控制，并保持了高油价。 特朗普还利用演讲瞄准国内政治对手，称他们为“狂热分子”。 讲述了一名在袭击中丧生的消防员的故事，他的儿子后来成为美国海军退伍军人，...

reflection.en: On a day meant for solemn remembrance, President Trump's speech at the Pentagon linked the tragedy of 9/11 to a call for action against Iran, while also touching on election politics. This moment highlights the difficult balance between national security, political maneuvering, and the spiritual call to overcome evil with good, as urged in Romans 12:21. The...
reflection.zh: 在这样一个本应肃穆悼念的日子里，特朗普总统在五角大楼的讲话将9/11的悲剧与对伊朗采取行动的呼吁联系起来，同时也涉及了选举政治。这一时刻凸显了国家安全、政治操纵以及以善胜恶的属灵呼召之间艰难的平衡，正如罗马书12:21所敦促的。用进一步的冲突来回应过去的邪恶，而不是寻求和平与和解的道路，这种诱惑是一种反复出现的人类挑战。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: The North Korean missile launch that South Korea is closely monitoring
title.zh: 韩国密切关注朝鲜导弹发射

summary.en: North Korea launched several short-range ballistic missiles early Saturday morning, which traveled approximately 250km before landing in the sea off its east coast. South Korean and US authorities are analyzing the specifications of these missiles.
summary.zh: 朝鲜于周六清晨发射了数枚短程弹道导弹，飞行约250公里后落在其东海岸外的海域。韩国和美国当局正在分析这些导弹的规格。

body.en:
North Korea fired several short-range ballistic missiles from the Wonsan area toward the sea off its east coast, South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) said on Saturday.

The missiles were launched from around 5.20am (6.20am AEST) and flew about 250km, the JCS said in a statement, adding that South Korean and US authorities were conducting a detailed analysis of their specifications.

South Korean and US intelligence authorities had tracked and shared information on the launches from the outset, while information on the ballistic missiles was also shared with Japan, the JCS said.

"South Korea's military is closely monitoring North Korean activity and maintaining the capability and readiness to respond overwhelmingly to any provocation under its combined defence posture with the United States," the JCS said in a statement.

South Korea's presidential National Security Office convened an emergency security meeting involving the defence ministry, the JCS and other relevant agencies following the launch, the presidential office said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Officials reviewed the government's response, assessed the impact of the launches on South Korea's security and examined necessary measures, the presidential office said. It urged North Korea to immediately stop ballistic missile launches, calling them a serious violation of UN Security Council resolutions.

Separately, US Pacific Command said it was aware of the launches and was consulting closely with allies and partners. It said the launches, based on its current assessment, did not pose an immediate threat to US personnel, territory or allies.

"The United States remains committed to the defense of the US homeland and our allies in the region," it said in a post on X.

Last month, North Korea launched more than 10 short-range ballistic missiles and ordered its military to maintain full readiness during South Korea's ongoing joint exercises with the United States.

Saturday's launch came a day after South Korea, Japan and the .S concluded their joint military drills to test readiness against North Korea's missile and nuclear weapons threats.

Separately last month, US President Donald Trump abruptly scaled back military drills, which he described as hostile to North Korea, and said he expected to meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un late this year.

summary.zh: 中国国家主席习近平在印度出席金砖国家峰会时受到红地毯欢迎，这被视为中印在2020年发生致命军事冲突后迈向和解的重要一步。尽管两国仍是地区竞争对手，但这种公开的缓和迹象表明，双方都有意稳定边境并在全球舞台上进行合作。

body.en: Chinese president’s arrival in Delhi seen as step towards reconciliation after deadly 2020 military clash The Chinese president, Xi Jinping, has received a red-carpet welcome in India for a summit of Brics developing nations, as regional rivals Beijing and Delhi make a public display of thawing relations while quietly competing to lead at a time of shaky US global dominance. title.en: BRICS summit leaders urge 'maximum restraint' in Middle East
title.zh: 金砖国家峰会领导人呼吁在中东“保持最大克制”

summary.en: Leaders at the BRICS 2026 summit issued a joint declaration expressing 'deep concern' over Middle East hostilities. Chinese President Xi Jinping stated that the war in Iran was not in the bloc's interest. India and China also committed to normalizing their disputed border.
summary.zh: 在金砖国家2026年峰会上，领导人们发表联合声明，对中东的敌对行动表示“深切关注”。中国国家主席习近平表示，伊朗战争不符合该集团的利益。印度和中国也承诺实现其争议边界的正常化。

body.en:
The joint declaration at the BRICS 2026 summit expressed 'deep concern' over hostilities in the Middle East. China's President Xi Jinping said the Iran war was not in the bloc's interest. Follow DW for more.

Tired of missing our real-time updates?  Click here to add us as a Preferred Source on Google . Then tap the "Star" or "Preferred" to keep DW News at the top of your feed.

Chinese President Xi Jinping called for Beijing to strengthen its financial cooperation with India during a visit to New Delhi for a BRICS summit.

"Both sides should… work hand-in-hand to promote high-quality major financial cooperation, advocate an equal and sustainable global order, and foster an economic globalization that is open and inclusive," Xi said.

Meanwhile, the Indian Foreign Ministry said that he and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi "underlined the need to address each other's concerns, including structural trade imbalance and supply chain issues, and facilitation of meaningful and predictable market access."

China is India's largest trading partner, with bilateral goods reaching $151 billion (€130 billion) in the financial year of 2025-26.

During this period, India imported $131 billion of goods from China, while India exported some $19 billion worth of goods to its neighbor.

India and China have "expressed commitment" to normalizing their disputed border, India's Foreign Ministry said.

"The two leaders expressed commitment to a fair, reasonable, and mutually acceptable resolution of the boundary question," the ministry said as Chinese President Xi Jinping visits New Delhi for a BRICS summit.

The ministry added the Prime Minister Narendra Modi "underlined the need for both sides to observe existing agreements and understandings on border related issues."

The statement said that Modi stressed that China and India both "must be guided by three mutuals — mutual respect, mutual sensitivity and mutual interest."

Both India and China maintain heavy military deployments along their 3,500 kilometer (2,175-mile) border along Kashmir and Tibet.

Chinese and Indian troops engaged in several skirmishes along the disputed border in 2020 and 2021.

Speaking at the BRICS Summit in New Delhi, Chinese President Xi Jinping called for greater efforts to promote peace in the Middle East and the Gulf region.

"China is willing to work with fellow BRICS members to play due role in achieving peace and stability in the Middle East and the Gulf region," President Xi Jinping told the official Xinhua news agency in New Delhi.

"The war has caused serious losses to people across the region and does not serve the common interests of the international community," Xi added, according to Xinhua.

title.en: India's BRICS strategy tested with Xi, Putin set to visit
title.zh: 印度金砖国家战略面临考验，习近平和普京即将访印

summary.en: India's 'America Plus' strategy involves strengthening ties with China and Russia while simultaneously attempting to prevent the BRICS bloc from becoming a platform against the West. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to host the BRICS summit in New Delhi, which will include Chinese President Xi Jinping's first visit...
summary.zh: 印度“美国加”战略涉及加强与中国和俄罗斯的联系，同时试图阻止金砖国家集团成为反西方平台。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪将主办金砖国家峰会，中国国家主席习近平自2019年以来首次访印，而印度与华盛顿的关系仍面临挑战。

body.en:
New Delhi's "America Plus" approach sees India deepening its ties with China and Russia, while also trying to keep BRICS from turning into an anti-Western platform.

India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi will host the 18th BRICS summit this weekend in New Delhi, welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping to India for the first time since 2019.   

The summit comes at an important moment for India . As New Delhi's year-long BRICS presidency draws to a close, India is stepping up engagement with China and Russia , and its relationship with Washington remains difficult .

Modi met both Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on August 31 and September 1. Just two weeks later, Modi is set to see them again in New Delhi for the BRICS summit.

But with BRICS both growing in size and increasingly troubled by internal divisions, the forum might limit Modi's diplomatic gains.

Indian diplomats are trying to protect their room for maneuver in a changing international order.

Ashok Kantha, a former Indian ambassador to China, said India's engagement with BRICS and the SCO is part of New Delhi's longstanding strategy of strategic autonomy.

"These groupings give India a seat at the table and allow it to pursue its own interests while maintaining relationships with different major powers," Kantha told DW.

However, as Modi prepares to host Xi in New Delhi, ties between India and China are less than ideal .

Both countries reached a border patrol agreement in 2024, ending a four-year military standoff along their disputed frontier.

International flights have resumed, the Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage has reopened and some visa restrictions have eased. But major problems remain between Beijing and New Delhi — India is reporting a trade deficit of over $112 billion (€96.5 billion) with China, and the two countries argue over market access.

The Modi-Xi meeting will therefore be watched for signs of a major diplomatic thaw, particularly on trade and investment.

Kantha said the visit could bring some stabilization but should not be mistaken for a reset.

"The border remains heavily militarized and major differences over trade, investment and security remain. India needs a stable and predictable relationship with China, but without lowering its guard," said Kantha.

"It is a relationship of armed coexistence and managed competition. We should not reduce it to a simple 'elephant and dragon' story," he said, referring to traditional symbols of the world's two most populous nations.

India's presidency has already exposed the difficulty of reaching agreement within BRICS, which has grown from its original five members to 11.

body.zh: 新德里的“美国+”方针让印度加深了与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时也试图阻止金砖国家变成一个反西方的平台。 印度总理莫迪将于本周末在新德里主办金砖国家领导人第十八次峰会，欢迎中国国家主席习近平自 2019 年以来首次访问印度。 此次峰会对印度来说正值重要时刻。随着新德里为期一年的金砖国家轮值主席国任期接近尾声，印度正在加强与中国和俄罗斯的接触，其与华盛顿的关系仍然困难。 莫迪于8月31日和9月1日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会上会见了习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。仅仅两周后，莫迪将在新德里出席金砖国家峰会时再次会见他们。 但随着金砖国家规模不断扩大，内部分歧日益困扰，该论坛可能会限制莫迪的外交成果。 印度外交官正试图在不断变化的国际秩序中保护自己的回旋余地。 印度前驻华大使阿肖克·坎塔表示，印度与金砖国家和上合组织的接触是新德里长期战略自主战略的一部分。 坎塔对德国之声表示：“这些组织让印度在谈判桌上占有一席之地，并使其能够在与不同大国保持关系的同时追求自身利益。” 然而，当莫迪准备在新德里接待习近平时，印度和中国之间的关系并不理想。 两国于 2024 年达成边境巡逻协议，结束了两国争议边境长达四年的军事对峙。 国际航班已恢复，神山朝圣活动已重新开放，一些签证限制也已放宽。但北京和新德里之间仍存在重大问题——印度报告的对华贸易逆差超过1120亿美元（965亿欧元），两国在市场准入问题上存在争议。 因此，莫迪与习近平的会晤将受到重大外交解冻的迹象，特别是在贸易和投资方面。 坎塔表示，这次访问可能会带来一些稳定，但不应被误认为是重置。 坎塔表示：“边境仍然高度军事化，贸易、投资和安全方面的重大分歧依然存在。印度需要与中国建立稳定和可预测的关系，但又不能放松警惕。” “这是一种武装共存和有管理的竞争的关系。我们不应将其简化为一个简单的‘象与龙’故事，”他说，他指的是世界上人口最多的两个国家的传统象征。 印度担任轮值主席国已经暴露了金砖国家内部达成协议的难度，金砖国家成员已从最初的5个增加到11个。 与巴西、南非、印度尼西亚等国家...

The upcoming BRICS summit in New Delhi, with leaders from China and Russia attending, presents an opportunity for dialogue and the pursuit of peace, even amidst complex international relations. May wisdom guide these leaders as they navigate the path toward mutual...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常被分裂所定义的世界上，印度的外交方针寻求微妙的平衡。即将在新德里举行的金砖国家峰会，中国和俄罗斯的领导人将出席，这为对话和寻求和平提供了机会，即使在复杂国际关系中也是如此。愿智慧引导这些领导人，在寻求相互理解与合作的道路上。

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……
